question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: Throw cold water on
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **To discourage an idea**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **“throw cold water on”** means to discourage, criticize, or dampen someone’s enthusiasm or ideas. (हतोत्साहित करना / किसी विचार को निरुत्साहित करना) • **Example:** She threw cold water on his plans to start a new business by pointing out all the potential risks. • **“To discourage an idea”** means to make someone feel less confident or enthusiastic about their idea or plan. (विचार को हतोत्साहित करना) • **Example:** Negative feedback from friends can sometimes discourage an idea before it even starts. • Hence, the idiom “throw cold water on” is best interpreted as “to discourage an idea.” Therefore, the correct answer is- To discourage an idea [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To boost excitement** (उत्साह बढ़ाना): To make someone more excited or enthusiastic. • **Example:** The coach boosted the team’s excitement before the big match. • **To ignore deliberately** (जानबूझकर अनदेखा करना): To purposely not pay attention. • **Example:** He ignored the question deliberately because he did not want to answer it. • **To celebrate loudly** (जोर से जश्न मनाना): To enjoy or rejoice in a very noisy way. • **Example:** The fans celebrated loudly after the team won the championship. 35:T946, The correct answer is** option 1.**
